description: Turnkey fit-out of cafés, restaurants, salons, shops, offices and mini-hotels: design, renovation, furnishing from China and launch by one team.

lead: We fit out commercial spaces turnkey: cafés and restaurants, beauty salons, shops, offices and mini-hotels. Design, renovation, furniture, lighting and decor from China and the launch — one manager and one estimate. You run your business, we take care of the premises.
facts: for Ukrainian sole traders and LLCs
cards: furniture for the hall and terrace
shop floor, displays and fitting rooms
about: Opening a venue is more than renovation. Guest and staff flows must be planned, engineering laid for equipment, furniture and lighting chosen to withstand daily use — and all of it ready by the opening date. We take the whole path on ourselves, with one manager, one schedule and regular photo reports.

Furniture, lighting, sanitary ware, textiles and tableware for commercial projects come directly from factories in China through our Ozdoba catalogue. Minimum order from $500; items can be combined, we do not sell single pieces. Delivery takes 30–60 days, so we order right after the specification is approved — in parallel with the renovation.
steps: Business format, premises, budget and opening date.
Engineering and finishing to the project, photo reports.
Ordered in parallel with renovation, delivery 30–60 days.
Installation, arrangement, styling — the space is ready to work.
faq: We take the premises from brief to opening: design, renovation, furnishing, delivery, installation and styling. You get a space ready to work and one person responsible for everything.
Design from $30 per m² (minimum $2 500), office renovation from $350 per m², furnishing from the Ozdoba catalogue from $500. Cafés, restaurants and salons are priced per project.
Can I order just one stage?
Yes — design only, renovation to your project, or furnishing only.
Do you issue invoices to companies?
Yes, for Ukrainian sole traders (FOP) and LLCs (TOV), with closing documents.
